name: Anything
tagline: AI agent that turns natural-language descriptions into working apps, sites, and tools.
description: Anything (formerly CreateAnything) is an AI app builder that generates mobile apps, websites, and internal tools from plain-English prompts, with real code, integrations, and custom domains. It targets non-technical founders and small teams who want functional products without hiring developers. Paid tiers add private projects, custom domains, parallel agents, and automated testing.
pricing_details: Free tier available. Pro is $19/mo with 20K monthly credits; Max is $199/mo with 220K credits, parallel agents, and automated testing. Teams pricing is custom.
use_cases: Building MVP web or mobile apps from prompts
Creating internal tools without engineers
Prototyping product ideas quickly
Launching sites with GPT-powered features and integrations
pros: Generates functional apps with real code, not just mockups
Includes 40+ integrations and AI features out of the box
Clear credit-based pricing with a free entry tier
cons: Credit limits constrain larger or iterative projects
Complex apps may still require developer cleanup
Branding removal and private projects require a paid plan
key_features: Prompt-to-app generation for mobile, web, and tools
Built-in GPT-5 and 40+ integrations
Custom domains and private projects
Max tier with parallel agents and automated testing
Credit-based usage system

name: Viktor
tagline: AI employee inside Slack and Microsoft Teams that completes tasks across 3,200+ tools.
description: Viktor is an AI coworker that operates inside Slack and Microsoft Teams, executing tasks end to end rather than just answering questions. It runs code on its own cloud computer, connects to over 3,200 workplace tools, and can deliver decks, dashboards, reports, and scheduled automations. Built by former Meta engineers and used by thousands of organizations, it is aimed at lean teams offloading repetitive operational work.
pricing_details: Free to start with up to $100 in credits and all features included, no credit card required. Paid plans start at $50/month.
use_cases: Automating recurring reports and digests
Auditing ad spend and business metrics
Building internal dashboards and small apps
Running cross-tool workflows from a single chat message
pros: Delivers finished work products, not just suggestions
Lives natively in Slack and Teams with fast setup
Approval controls for irreversible actions
Broad integration coverage across 3,200+ tools
cons: Only useful if your team works in Slack or Teams
Per-action credit costs can add up on heavy usage
Less customizable than building agents yourself
who_its_for: Founders doing too much manual work
Teams standardized on Slack or Microsoft Teams
key_features: AI employee with its own cloud computer for running code
3,200+ tool integrations
Scheduled and recurring task automation
Approval gates and per-person permissions
Company memory that retains decisions and preferences

name: Marblism
tagline: A team of six AI employees that runs your inbox, social media, SEO, leads, calls, and contracts.
description: Marblism provides a bundle of six named AI employees — covering inbox management, social media, SEO content, lead generation, phone reception, and contract review — under one subscription. It integrates with Gmail, Outlook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and other common small-business tools and works autonomously in the background. The product targets solopreneurs and small businesses that cannot justify hiring for each role.
pricing_details: Plans start at $24/month on annual billing; every plan includes all 6 AI employees, 50 monthly hours of AI work, unlimited team members, and unlimited businesses. 7-day money-back guarantee.
use_cases: Triaging and drafting replies to a busy inbox
Keeping social media channels posting consistently
Publishing SEO blog articles on autopilot
Prospecting and outbound lead generation
Answering inbound calls and booking appointments
pros: Six business functions covered in one low-cost subscription
No prompting skill required; works autonomously
Integrates with common email, social, and calendar tools
7-day full refund guarantee
cons: Each AI employee is a generalist, not best-in-class per function
50-hour monthly work cap with paid top-ups
No SOC 2 certification reported, limiting regulated-industry use
key_features: Six role-based AI employees (inbox, social, SEO, leads, calls, legal)
Autonomous background operation with approval check-ins
Integrations with Gmail, Outlook, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X
AI receptionist with US/CA/UK phone numbers
Hours-based usage with monthly resets and top-ups

name: Appy.AI
tagline: Violet, an AI business partner in Slack and Teams, delegates work to specialist AI agents.
description: Appy.AI lets teams hire AI coworkers that work inside Slack and Microsoft Teams. Users state a goal in plain English and Violet, the coordinator agent, plans the work, delegates to specialist agents, and delivers results with a full audit trail. It connects to 900+ applications and supports recurring, scheduled, and third-party-triggered tasks for lean business teams.
pricing_details: Free starter with $100 in credits, no card required. Team plans start from $50/month per workspace (not per seat), per the company's own comparison pages.
use_cases: Delegating research, writing, and analysis tasks in Slack
Running recurring automated business tasks
Coordinating multi-step work across connected apps
Creating custom AI coworkers for company-specific workflows
pros: Zero-setup adoption inside existing Slack/Teams channels
Coordinator-plus-specialists model produces structured, trackable work
Full audit logs and task ownership for accountability
Custom AI coworkers can be created by asking
cons: Pricing beyond the free credits is not published in detail
Limited to teams already living in Slack or Teams
Newer entrant with a smaller public track record
who_its_for: Lean teams doing more with less
Startups on Slack or Microsoft Teams
Managers wanting delegated AI work without new tooling
key_features: Violet coordinator agent that plans and delegates
Specialist AI agents for research, writing, analysis, outreach
900+ app integrations
Recurring and third-party-triggered scheduled tasks
Activity stream with structured tasks, assets, and audit logs

name: Chipp
tagline: No-code platform to build, deploy, and sell branded AI agents without an engineering team.
description: Chipp is a no-code platform for building custom AI agents trained on a business's own knowledge, deployable to web chat, WhatsApp, Slack, phone, and other channels. It includes built-in payments so builders can sell agents or agent bundles, plus white-label and HIPAA-compliant tiers. Based in Fargo, North Dakota, it reports 125,000+ agents built and 14M+ conversations served.
pricing_details: Free to start. Builder $29/mo (+ usage over $10 included), Studio $99/mo (+ usage over $30), Studio Pro $299/mo (+ usage over $100) with zero data retention and HIPAA. Enterprise and add-ons (white-label $999/mo, HIPAA $249/mo) available.
use_cases: Customer support agents trained on company docs
White-label AI chatbots for agency clients
Voice agents answering phones and booking appointments
Selling branded AI agents as a productized service
pros: True no-code agent builder with 40+ templates
Omnichannel deployment including WhatsApp and phone
Built-in monetization and white-label options
SOC 2 Type II with HIPAA and zero-data-retention tiers
cons: Usage-based overages can surprise heavy deployments
Advanced privacy features locked to the $299/mo tier
Template quality varies; serious agents need tuning
key_features: Prompt-based agent builder with knowledge uploads
Deployment to web, WhatsApp, Slack, Discord, email, voice/phone
Built-in Stripe payments for selling agents
Voice AI with cloning and call transcripts
White-label platform and client management add-ons
SOC 2, GDPR, and HIPAA compliance options

name: Durable
tagline: AI website builder that generates a business site in 30 seconds, plus CRM, invoicing, and marketing.
description: Durable is an AI business builder that generates a complete website in about 30 seconds from three questions, then bundles CRM, booking, invoicing, payments, and AI marketing tools in one subscription. It targets solopreneurs and small service businesses that want to replace multiple tools with a single platform. The Vancouver-based company reports millions of websites generated since launch.
pricing_details: Free $0 plan (durable.site subdomain, 5 images/mo, 10 AI chat messages/mo). Launch $25/mo and Grow $49/mo, with discounted annual rates ($22/mo and $41/mo respectively).
use_cases: Launching a service-business website in minutes
Managing leads and customers in a built-in CRM
Sending invoices and accepting payments
Generating ads, logos, and social content with AI
Automating blog posts and review collection
pros: Fastest path from idea to live site — under a minute
Replaces several subscriptions (site, CRM, booking, invoicing)
Genuine free tier for testing a business idea
Strong user ratings (4.8 on Trustpilot per the site)
cons: Limited design and code customization versus traditional builders
Not designed for full e-commerce
Best features (AI agents, SEO/GEO) gated to paid plans
who_its_for: Non-technical founders needing an online presence fast
key_features: AI website generation in ~30 seconds
Built-in CRM, booking, invoicing, and payments
AI agents for blogging, reviews, and lead replies
AI image, ad, and logo generation
SEO and GEO (AI-search visibility) tools
Free custom domain on paid plans

name: Magic Patterns
tagline: AI design tool that generates UI prototypes matching your existing product and design system.
description: Magic Patterns is an AI design tool for product teams that generates UI from prompts and matches the styling of an existing product or imported design system. It supports rapid prototyping, live team collaboration, GitHub sync, and MCP integration, with export toward production workflows. Developed by North Park Labs, it is used by tens of thousands of product teams for exploring features before engineering commits.
pricing_details: Free tier available. Starter $20/seat/mo (1K credits) and Business $100/seat/mo (5K credits, SSO, usage reporting), billed annually. Enterprise is custom.
use_cases: Prototyping new features before engineering work
Generating UI variations that match an existing design system
Testing design concepts directly with customers
Collaborating between design and engineering on live prototypes
pros: Output matches your real product styling, not generic mockups
Fast idea-to-prototype loop praised by product teams
Design-system import and GitHub/MCP integrations
SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified
cons: Credit-based pricing makes heavy iteration costly
Per-seat pricing scales up quickly for larger teams
Generated code typically still needs engineering refinement
who_its_for: Enterprise product teams with design systems
key_features: Prompt-to-UI generation matching existing products
Design system import for consistent prototyping
Real-time team collaboration and sharing
GitHub sync and MCP support
Credit-based usage with monthly rollover
Enterprise security (SOC 2, ISO 27001, SSO, SCIM)

name: FLORA
tagline: Infinite canvas that combines 50+ text, image, and video AI models into one creative workflow.
description: FLORA is a node-based infinite canvas for creative professionals that unifies dozens of leading text, image, and video AI models in a single subscription and workflow. Teams use it to ideate, iterate in real time, and scale concepts into production-grade assets, with reusable workflow templates called Techniques. Founded in 2024 by Weber Wong, it counts design firms, film studios, and brand teams among its users.
pricing_details: Free plan available. Paid plans are seat-based with a shared workspace usage pool metered at published model rates; third-party listings report Starter around $18/seat/mo, Pro $50, and Max $200.
use_cases: Creative concepting and mood-board exploration
Campaign previz and virtual product shoots
Brand identity and asset generation at scale
Video pre-production and visual effects experiments
Team-based iteration across image and video models
pros: One subscription covers 50+ models, updated as new ones release
Node-based canvas gives real creative control and reproducibility
Pooled team usage with per-project cost visibility
Strong adoption among professional studios and agencies
cons: Learning curve for the node-based workflow
Usage costs can grow quickly with video models
Official per-seat prices are not prominently published on the site
key_features: Infinite canvas unifying text, image, and video models
FAUNA creative agent for ideation and direction
Reusable workflow templates (Techniques)
Real-time team collaboration
Pooled workspace budget with per-member usage tracking
Access to 50+ models including Veo, Kling, FLUX, and Gemini

name: Hedra
tagline: AI creation platform for character-driven video, image, and audio, powered by the Character-3 model.
description: Hedra is a generative media platform best known for turning a single image and audio clip into expressive talking or singing character videos using its proprietary Character-3 model. Hedra Studio combines video, image, and audio generation from its own and partner models on an infinite canvas, with an API for developers. Founded in 2023 in San Francisco and backed by Andreessen Horowitz, it reports over 20 million users.
pricing_details: Free plan with no credit card required. Basic $15/mo (1,500 credits), Creator $30/mo (5,400 credits), Professional and Teams $75/mo (14,400 credits); Enterprise is custom. Monthly credits do not roll over.
use_cases: Talking-avatar videos from a photo and voice clip
Character-driven marketing and social content
AI-generated imagery and audio alongside video
Developer integrations via the Hedra API
pros: Character-3 produces notably expressive, lip-synced characters
Simple pipeline: one image plus audio yields a finished video
Free plan and low entry price for individuals
Combines proprietary and partner models in one studio
cons: Monthly credits expire with no rollover on subscription plans
Generation speed gated behind higher tiers
Focused on character video rather than general text-to-video
who_its_for: Content creators and social media teams
Developers building on a video-generation API
key_features: Character-3 omnimodal model for talking/singing avatars
Hedra Studio infinite canvas for video, image, and audio
Hedra Agent for creative planning and execution
Credit-based usage across multiple partner models
Commercial use rights on all paid plans
Enterprise options with private deployments and SSO
